situations.headline: Amigo Resources: first gravity-gold output (10kg Aug) ahead of Q4 plant/leach-circuit commissioning

changelog.entry: stage-2 assessment: Amigo Resources: first gravity-gold output (10kg Aug) ahead of Q4 plant/leach-circuit commissioning (interest 5, risk 7)

thesis.text: Amigo Resources is a micro-cap Tanzania-focused gold developer transitioning from pilot gravity recovery to an integrated gravity+CIL+flotation plant; the August 10kg output confirms free-gold recoverability but scale, cost, and sustainability remain unproven pending Q4 2026 plant commissioning and the promised return to monthly financial disclosure, making this a speculative, catalyst-driven situation with high operational and disclosure risk until independently verified production/revenue data emerges.
